hints.title: 2D Block Window Accumulation Obstacle
hints.text: Summing all elements in a (2k + 1) x (2k + 1) bounding box for each cell requires avoiding repeated nested summation over overlapping sub-matrices. How can a 2D cumulative sum table query any subgrid in constant time?

hints.title: Inclusion-Exclusion Rectangle Query Invariant
hints.text: The sum of elements in rectangle (r1, c1) to (r2, c2) is pref[r2+1][c2+1] - pref[r1][c2+1] - pref[r2+1][c1] + pref[r1][c1].

hints.title: Prefix Table Construction and Box Query Procedure
hints.text: Build a 2D prefix sum array of size (m + 1) x (n + 1). For every cell (i, j), clamp bounding box boundaries: r1 = max(0, i - k), c1 = max(0, j - k), r2 = min(m - 1, i + k), c2 = min(n - 1, j + k). Apply the inclusion-exclusion formula to assign the block sum in O(1) time. Return the result matrix.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Building the prefix matrix takes O(M * N); each of the M * N queries is evaluated in O(1) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating over every cell's (2k + 1) x (2k + 1) window takes O(M * N * K^2) which is too slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 2D prefix table requires O(M * N) auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Properly clamping boundary coordinates to avoid out-of-bounds indexing in the prefix matrix.
